latest_events.title: Burkina Faso’s rival armed groups turn on each other as state loses ground
latest_events.summary: Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso – Armed fighters from two rival groups have fought a series of increasingly deadly battles along Burkina Faso’s northern border with Mali, as the government struggles to reassert control over large parts of the country. The clashes between Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM), an al-Qaeda affiliate, and the ISIL affiliate in Sahel Province (ISSP) have intensified since early September, with both groups competing for territory and influence across the borderlands.

latest_events.title: JNIM Claims IED Attack on Malian Army and Africa Corps Vehicle Between Sévaré and Konna
latest_events.summary: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), al-Qaeda's Sahel affiliate, says it targeted a vehicle carrying Malian army and Russian Africa Corps personnel with an improvised explosive device on the morning of Monday, 2 November 2026. The claimed strike took place on the road between Sévaré and Konna in Mali's Mopti region. Casualties, damage and even the exact location rest on JNIM's claim alone and should be treated as unverified.
